statusText: EA_ON / green: NQ is closed and Tail remains low; Gulf escalation keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the Sunday Globex reopening remains the main conditional Tail checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress before Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed, so no live one-way path is observable. Saudi and Gulf equities weakened after Houthi attack claims, while U.S.-China talks add policy uncertainty. Tail stays low until live futures structure is available.

At the scheduled Globex reopen, WATCH reflects conditional gap and whipsaw risk; persistent Tail would require shallow pullbacks or repeated extension.

forecast.analysis: If the first post-open hour shows repeated extension after failed retracements, Tail could stay near WATCH; orderly two-way trade would reduce it.
If price discovery remains disorderly into the second post-open hour, WATCH persists; meaningful retracements would weaken the Tail case.
If NQ establishes two-way trade by 01:00 UTC, the base case falls below WATCH; renewed one-way extension would invalidate that easing.
If volatility decays and pullbacks remain meaningful, Tail should continue easing while Stress stays high from the macro and geopolitical backdrop.
If overnight trade remains balanced, lower Tail is consistent with mean reversion functioning despite elevated headline risk.
If no fresh energy or security shock appears, the overnight regime should remain lower-Tail even with elevated background Stress.
If Asian-hours liquidity produces ordinary retracements, Tail should remain low; a sustained extreme-hold would be the key contrary signal.
If cross-assets stay mixed rather than fully aligned, the evidence should continue to favor high Stress without a Tail block.
drivers: High Stress does not by itself imply Tail

forecast.analysis: If overnight NQ remains rotational, the low-Tail regime should persist into the European handoff.
If Europe introduces a directional impulse, retracement depth and semiconductor or megacap confirmation would determine whether Tail rises.
If the European move remains two-way, Tail should stay low; repeated extension with aligned yields and oil would strengthen the contrary case.
If Europe remains orderly into late morning, Tail should stay low; stronger one-way alignment would be the main reason to revise higher.

forecastDetail.comment: Current NQ trading is unavailable; Gulf weakness lifts Stress without observed one-way NQ structure.
Closed-market uncertainty remains the main constraint; Tail stays low if headlines do not deteriorate.
Gulf export-routing resilience is a partial energy offset while live NQ structure remains unavailable.
U.S.-China talks add policy uncertainty, but no NQ price response can be observed before futures reopen.
China's unchanged LPRs are largely expected and add little incremental directional pressure.
Absent a fresh Saudi energy shock, risk remains concentrated in the later reopening gap.
